scope: Three isolated offline Windows native processes. Standard menu continue and pause save. The first dispatch used a temporary one-cell navigation obstruction, reverted immediately at button return. Final routes and natural settlement ran on ordinary terrain.

feedback_by_language.en: No wounded companions outside camp are awaiting orders. Select one and press J to stop before sending them back.
feedback_by_language.ja: 陣営の外に指示待ちの負傷者はいません。呼び戻すには、負傷者を選んで J キーで停止してください。
feedback_by_language.zh_CN: 当前没有待令的未归营伤员。改派可先选人按 J 停止。
feedback_by_language.zh_TW: 目前沒有待令的未歸營傷員。改派可先選人按 J 停止。

hint_during_test_obstruction: 已派3名伤员返回前营。其余待令伤员暂时找不到通路。
